title: 'Just because you are right, doesn't mean I am wrong': Overcoming a Bottleneck in the Development and Evaluation of Open-Ended Visual Question Answering (VQA) Tasks
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical aspects of creating and evaluating visual question answering (VQA) datasets. It proposes a new metric (AAS) to account for multiple semantically correct answers but does not discuss or evaluate any topics related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
